moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is underway, with today seeing Hull City take on Manchester United and Brentford facing Spurs later.

angles.name: Today's Matches
angles.copy: Premier League is back! Today's big clashes include Hull City vs Manchester United and Brentford vs Spurs. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Football fans, your Saturday is sorted! Catch the Premier League action today. Will there be any early upsets?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot for a second week with 'Rein Me In' on the Official UK Singles Chart, while Shakira & Burna Boy are holding strong at number two.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are Number 1 for another week with 'Rein Me In'. Any challengers for next week?

angles.name: New Music Vibes
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at Number 2 on the Official Singles Chart. What are your weekend listening essentials?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Concludes
moments.blurb: Wales' Green Man Festival wraps up tomorrow, Sunday 23rd August, after a weekend featuring Mogwai, Four Tet, Wilco, and Wolf Alice, with the traditional Green Man burning cancelled due to fire risk.

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: It's the final day of Green Man Festival tomorrow! Who caught Mogwai, Four Tet, or Wolf Alice? Sad to hear the Green Man burning is off.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Wrap
angles.copy: Big crowds and great music at Green Man this weekend, even with the Green Man burning cancelled due to dry conditions. What was your festival highlight?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shaun Ryder!
moments.blurb: Happy 64th Birthday tomorrow to Happy Mondays and Black Grape frontman, Shaun Ryder, born August 23, 1962.

angles.name: Madchester Icon
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the one and only Shaun Ryder tomorrow! The Happy Mondays and Black Grape legend. What's your favourite Ryder track?

angles.name: Indie Royalty
angles.copy: Step On! Tomorrow, we're celebrating the 64th birthday of Happy Mondays' main man, Shaun Ryder. Still bringing the noise!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Julian Casablancas!
moments.blurb: The Strokes frontman Julian Casablancas turns 48 tomorrow, August 23rd, born in 1978.

angles.name: Strokes Icon
angles.copy: Is This It? Nope, it's Julian Casablancas' 48th birthday tomorrow! Happy Birthday to The Strokes' iconic frontman.

angles.name: Indie Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're raising a glass to Julian Casablancas on his 48th birthday. Still one of the coolest voices in indie rock.

moments.title: Premier League Monday Night Football
moments.blurb: Matchweek 2 of the Premier League kicks off with Fulham hosting Chelsea on Monday, August 24.

angles.name: MNF
angles.copy: Monday Night Football is back! Fulham vs Chelsea on August 24th. Who's taking the three points?

angles.name: London Derby
angles.copy: A London derby to start the week! Fulham host Chelsea on Monday. Get ready for some capital city rivalry!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Gene Simmons!
moments.blurb: Kiss bassist and co-founder Gene Simmons turns 77 on Tuesday, August 25th, born in 1949.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Happy 77th Birthday to Kiss legend Gene Simmons on Tuesday. What's your favourite Kiss anthem?

angles.name: Demon Birthday
angles.copy: Tuesday marks the 77th birthday of The Demon himself, Gene Simmons! Still rocking after all these years.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Elvis Costello!
moments.blurb: The legendary singer-songwriter Elvis Costello celebrates his 72nd birthday on Tuesday, August 25th, born in 1954.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday on Tuesday to the incredible Elvis Costello! A true songwriting genius.

angles.name: Still Brilliant
angles.copy: From 'Pump It Up' to 'Alison', Elvis Costello's catalogue is timeless. Wishing him a very Happy 72nd Birthday on August 25th!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shirley Manson!
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson turns 60 on Wednesday, August 26th, born in 1966.

angles.name: Grunge Queen
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the iconic Shirley Manson of Garbage on Wednesday! Still pushing boundaries after all these years.

angles.name: Garbage Star
angles.copy: Only Happy When It Rains... but we're happy to celebrate Shirley Manson's 60th birthday on August 26th! What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Valerie Simpson!
moments.blurb: Motown legend Valerie Simpson, half of the iconic duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 78th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th, born in 1948.

angles.name: Soulful Songwriter
angles.copy: Ain't No Mountain High Enough to stop us celebrating Valerie Simpson's 78th birthday on Wednesday! A true Motown and soul icon.

angles.name: Ashford & Simpson
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson on August 26th. Her songwriting legacy is unparalleled!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Weekend
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off on Thursday, August 27th, running through the Bank Holiday weekend with headliners including Chase & Status, Dave, and Charli XCX.

angles.name: Festival Alert
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festivals are almost here! Kicking off Thursday for the Bank Holiday weekend. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Beats
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest Bank Holiday party! Reading & Leeds bring the noise from Thursday. Expect huge sets and festival vibes.

moments.title: All Points East Begins
moments.blurb: London's All Points East Festival starts on Friday, August 28th, bringing a huge line-up to Victoria Park across the weekend.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: Victoria Park, get ready! All Points East kicks off on Friday, August 28th. Who's heading to London for the festival fun?

angles.name: East London Vibes
angles.copy: Big weekend of music coming to East London with All Points East starting Friday. Perfect for that Bank Holiday weekend build-up!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shania Twain!
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain turns 61 on Friday, August 28th, born in 1965.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Let's Go Girls! Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain on Friday. Still sounds good, looks good, feels good!

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: From 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' to 'That Don't Impress Me Much', Shania Twain is a legend. Happy 61st Birthday on August 28th!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Florence Welch!
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine frontwoman Florence Welch celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28th, born in 1986.

angles.name: Indie Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch on Friday! Her voice is pure magic.

angles.name: Musical Force
angles.copy: From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', Florence Welch has given us so many anthems. Wishing her a fantastic 40th on August 28th!

moments.title: Guildhall Live Festival in Exeter
moments.blurb: Exeter's Guildhall Live, a free three-day music festival, takes over Market Square from Saturday 29th to Monday 31st August, celebrating 50 years of Guildhall Shopping Exeter with tribute acts and local talent.

angles.name: Exeter Festival
angles.copy: Free music alert for Exeter! Guildhall Live brings three days of tribute acts and local talent to Market Square from Saturday 29th August. Don't miss it!

angles.name: Devon Bank Holiday
angles.copy: Planning your Bank Holiday weekend in Devon? Guildhall Live in Exeter is serving up free music from the 70s to today, Saturday to Monday!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Monday
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: Who's ready for the August Bank Holiday weekend? Monday, August 31st means an extra day off for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland!

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: Make the most of the last long weekend of summer! The August Bank Holiday is just around the corner on Monday 31st. How are you spending it?
